name: lh2sidecar
description: Load harness LH-2 sidecar extension — exposes lh2sidecar:1:install_subscription(channel) which calls pubsub.subscribe against a cross-extension Layer-3 channel to exercise the broker's per-bc JS fan-out arm; lh2sidecar:1:read_counters() returns the observed envelope count + lag samples at harness teardown. Named lh2sidecar (not ICD's ext_lh2_sidecar) because manifest name and channel-extension segment both reject underscores; same precedent as lh1storm.
author: plinth-load-harness
